title: Book 9 — Calliope, Chapter 115
paragraphs: To this town of Sestos — since it was the greatest stronghold in that region — men had gathered from the cities around when they heard that the Greeks had arrived at the Hellespont; especially Oiobazos, a Persian, had come from the city of Cardia, bringing to Sestos the ropes of the bridges. The inhabitants of the city were Aiolians, natives of the country, but there were also living with them a great number of Persians and their allies.
